autoconfig.sol_valheim.title: SOL: Valheim
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.def: Duration is nutrition × saturation modifier × this value, with a minimum of 5 minutes.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.reg: Higher values slow regeneration; lower values speed it up.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.res: During this period you can sprint without eating.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.spe: Speed bonus when food grants at least 20 health points; 0 disables it.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.sta: Base hearts before food bonuses. Other mods can still add health.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.max: Number of food slots, from 2 to 5. Drinks use a separate slot.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.eat: Replace or refresh food below this fraction of its duration, or during the final minute.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.dri: While a drink is active, multiply health and regeneration by 1 plus this value.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.pas: Account for skipped night time without increasing existing timers.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.common.foo: Edit the JSON5 configuration file to customize individual foods.
autoconfig.sol_valheim.option.client.use: Enlarge the food icons; timer text stays at native font scale.
commands.sol_valheim.reload.failed: Could not reload SOL: Valheim configuration. Check the server log.
